messages:
people-ops: Heads up — a 10-day attestation + evidence pickup window opens Monday 2026-04-06. All team leads, please confirm evidence owners in the tracker by EOD this Friday. Link: https://drive.redwood.company/compliance/evidence-tracker :calendar:

devon.h: Quick Q — do contractors need to upload artifacts too, and are there format requirements?

people-ops: Yes — contractors included. Use the 'Evidence v2' template in the Drive folder. Acceptable artifacts: PDFs, Markdown runbooks, or hosted links (add a short README). Minimal template snippet:
```
- owner: name + email
- control mapping: SOC2 CC/ISO clause
- artifact link: https://...
- short description
```

sanjay.k: For infra logging artifacts, what level of redaction is okay for shared examples?
\ninfra-team-bot: deploy: infra-runbook-v2 published -> https://internal.runbooks/redwood/infra-runbook-v2 (auto-post)

lisa_c: I won't be able to make the live office hours next week. Will it be recorded?

people-ops: :white_check_mark: We'll record both sessions and post the recording + notes in #announcements. Office hours: Tue 2026-04-07 10:00 PT (evidence triage) and Thu 2026-04-09 16:00 PT (exceptions walk-through).

devon.h: If a team needs an exception for a late artifact, what's the approval path?

people-ops: Fill the Exception Request form here: https://forms.redwood.company/compliance-exception and tag @people-ops and your Eng Manager. Exceptions must be requested before 17:00 PT on Mon 2026-04-13 to be considered.

sanjay.k: Will owners get auto-reminders before the deadline?

people-ops: Yes — automated nudges at 48h and 24h before a team's deadline, then escalation to the Eng Manager. We also run a light audit next Wednesday 2026-04-08. Escalation flow docs: https://internal.docs.redwood/company/compliance/escalation

lisa_c: Can we add a sample of obfuscated logs to the template? Security asked for a redaction example.

eng-security-bot: policy-check: redaction guidance and a sample obfuscated-log artifact added to Evidence v2 template (see Drive).

people-ops: Reminder for team leads: update the tracker with owner emails + expected artifact links by EOD Fri. We'll pull the first audit report mid-next-week and share a summary. :bell: Ping me or @people-ops if anything blocks you. Thanks!
